name: Iris Of Yutaine
source:
Magic Affinity: Water 

A few words come to mind at first sight of Yutaine's second princess: elegance, grace, and beauty. 

Beyond initial impressions, Iris comes off as detached and cold with rumors about her past conduct isolating her even further from the social scene. Regardless of her supposed behaviors, she is an incredible alchemist in her own right.

Calm and steadfast, Iris performs well on any task assigned to her. As well, under that icy surface, you may find a surprisingly kindhearted soul.

[From Kickstarter]
